reviews.comment: Exactly as described, no problems, love the look, quality, lighting, and the quick pop in installation made getting back into gaming extremely fast. memtest86 8 passes, 8 hours, no errors.
reviews.author: Jason G.

reviews.title: Great performing, looking ram
reviews.comment: Holy Moly! I bought the 64GB Kit. 2x32GB CL 30-40-40-96 6000MT EXPO for $230 in 2023. I should of bought and horded as much as I could afford if anybody knew. I've never seen old hardware go up in price, like the AM4 AMD 5800x3d used, is going for over the price of my 7800X3d! Next thing you know DDR4 price is going to eventually go up in price. SAMSUNG is having a tough time selling RAM to their own sister companies. Don't upgrade from what you have, unless it's DDR4 platform. Maybe CPU/GPU upgrade if already on a DDR4 comliant motherboard. My kit mentioned above was easy to install. Price was great when I purchased. Hits the optimal speeds for my 7800x3d no complaints. Can overclock easily but keep them at stock. Looks great with the RGB.
reviews.author: xx78xx

reviews.title: Top-Tier Performance and Stunning RGB
reviews.comment:
The G.SKILL Trident Z5 Neo RGB memory modules are an absolute powerhouse. These are not only incredibly fast and reliable, but they also look amazing with their stunning RGB lighting. The AMD Expo compatibility is seamless, and the performance boost is noticeable in both gaming and heavy workloads. Installing them was effortless, and they ran perfectly from the start with no issues.
The RGB lighting is a real highlight, providing a customizable and vibrant look to my build. It’s a great balance of performance and aesthetics, and I’m really impressed with the overall quality. If you're looking to upgrade your system with high-performance RAM that also looks fantastic, this is an excellent choice.
reviews.author: Hades

reviews.title: Works well, no issues or failures after extended use.
reviews.comment: This memory works great. Once I got the timings sorted out on my motherboard the memory is quite stable and runs without any issues. The RGB lighting is pretty decent, and it's subtle, not flashy or obnoxious.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great memory, great price, and it works
reviews.comment:
I previously had the 32 GB (2x16GB) version of this memory, RGB and all.  I needed to upgrade to 64 GB.  My original intent was to buy another 32 GB kit and fill all four of my DIMMs to get the 64 GB.  Alas, my Be Quite CPU cooler's fan extended far enough out it covered up a DIMM forcing me to get a 64 Gig kit.  The 32 GB version of this was so solid, I went with the 64 GB kit.  I'm glad I did.  Nothing but good to say which includes:
- At the time I bought this, the price was a steal for 64 Gigs.
- The memory is rock solid and performs.  In fact, it has better timings than the 32 Gig kit.  In particular, the CL is quite a bit lower.
- RGB looks great if you are into that kind of thing.
- EXPO worked as expected in my ASUS board.  Just plugged in the memory, entered BIOS and enabled EXPO.
- The memory just works.  Plain and simple.  No fuss or anything, the way it should be.
This is just fantastic memory.  Get it.
reviews.author: Christopher Smith
